```lean
intros hf hg
constructor
intro h
have hfg : ∀ z ∈ upper_half_plane, f z * g z ≠ 0 :=
  λ z hz, (hf $ λ w hw, (λ hz', hz' ▸ h w hw) (hz' := hz)) (hg $ λ w hw, (λ hz', hz' ▸ h w hw) (hz' := hz))
contrapose! h
intro hz
have hz' : ∃ z ∈ upper_half_plane, f z * g z = 0 :=
  ⟨z, hz, hz⟩
cases hz' with z hz
have hz'' : f z * g z = 0 :=
  hz
rw [mul_eq_zero_iff] at hz''
cases hz'' with hfx hgx
exact hf (λ w hw, hfx (λ hz', hz' ▸ h w hw) (hz' := hz))
exact hg (λ w hw, hgx (λ hz', hz' ▸ h w hw) (hz' := hz))
```
